scope: Read-only exact-0.2.566 member first-turn Page Text failure diagnosis; no repository edits, Git mutation, UI/CDP action, model call, or credential access

candidate.runtime: Store ZIP candidate adapted only at manifest key according to native worker report; runtime tree SHA and modified-path claim belong to that report, not independently reproduced here

observed: Owned fresh guest Chrome profile: first turn and same-conversation follow-up each showed a Page Text tool card and terminal grounded assistant prose, per native worker snapshot.

Native final report: approved existing non-admin member signed in (first-party whoami 200 and extension Settings signed-in), normal panel reload opened fresh Chat on the public demo page. First send was accepted and showed Page Text/Processing, then terminal API error: 504 with Retry/Details, Stop absent/Send restored, and no assistant prose. The worker reports exact failing endpoint and tool-result/resume status as not captured.

Guest transcript retained after sign-in and Capture list unavailable with inert controls were provisional; driver activation was not excluded at that phase. They are distinct from the subsequently observed 504.
first_defensible_failure_boundary: HTTP 504 surfaced as a terminal Chat error after Page Text appeared. Available evidence does not identify the URL/endpoint that returned 504 or whether it came from the original agent stream, tool_results POST, or resume stream. Thus neither extension nor aidream root cause is proven.
exact_source_paths: src/lib/api/stream.ts: streamFetch turns a non-2xx stream-open response into a safe HTTP error and done; a 504 here could be original start or resume.

src/lib/tools/dispatch.ts: STREAM_CHUNK tool_delegated dispatches the handler and postResult delivers its output; a failed tool_results POST emits a tool timeline error and can leave the loop suspended.
src/lib/api/routes/tool-results.ts: tool_results retries 5xx three times and validates continuation_needed.
src/hooks/use-chat-stream.ts: STREAM_CONTINUE invokes resumeRun; a 504 from that stream presents a Chat error and Retry.
src/lib/stream/resume.ts: stall recovery can also invoke resumeRun after 75 seconds of silence.
